businesses.business: vegetation management and infrastructure maintenance equipment

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures mowers, vegetation management equipment, street sweepers, vacuum trucks, snow removal and other infrastructure maintenance equipment. Sells to government agencies, contractors, utilities, farmers and industrial users, mainly through dealers, and also supplies replacement parts.

primary_products.value: mowers and roadside/right-of-way vegetation cutters; street sweepers; vacuum excavators and sewer cleaners; snow removal equipment; agricultural implements and replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2G: municipalities, state highway departments, airports and public works agencies; B2B: contractors, utilities, railroads, farmers, rental companies and industrial operators

end_markets.value: municipal and public works; roadside and right-of-way maintenance; agriculture; utilities; industrial

revenue_model.value: product sales: new equipment and attachments sold to dealers and direct customers; product sales: aftermarket replacement parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds equipment from purchased steel, engines, hydraulics and components, sold to dealers, government and commercial customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe (UK, France, Netherlands), Brazil, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: industrial vegetation, infrastructure maintenance and agricultural equipment sharing customers and dealer channels

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent equipment dealers; direct sales: government agencies and large accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: emissions, product safety and trade rules (EPA, OSHA, tariffs), government procurement requirements
